# ABRIDGE Agriculture & Trade Co., Ltd. (주식회사 에이브릿지) — www.abridge.co.kr

> Korea–China trading company based in Gwangju, South Korea (part of BRIDGE GROUP with Ecobridge and DealBridge). Core supply lines, producer-direct from licensed Chinese producers: rare earth oxides/metals/alloys, Chinese semiconductor components, and 5N/6N high-purity copper. Also: HDPE/LLDPE/LDPE polyethylene distribution, BOPP/BOPET/nylon films, PBAT/PLA biodegradable materials, aT state-trading grains (rice 30,000 t quota, corn), mushrooms, hafnium and battery metals.

Pages: Korean (/), English (/index_en.html), Chinese (/index_zh.html). Specifications, live China spot prices and RFQ forms for the core supply lines are on the group terminal https://chinanews.kr/supply/ (Korean: https://chinanews.kr/ko/supply/).

## Core supply lines
- Rare earths from China — https://chinanews.kr/supply/rare-earths.html (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb, Y, La, Ce and the full lanthanide range; oxides 3N–5N, metals, PrNd/DyFe alloys; COA; samples from 100 g; export licence handled)
- Chinese semiconductors sourcing — https://chinanews.kr/supply/semiconductors.html (MCU, MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN, memory, analog/PMIC, sensors, LEDs; authorised channels only; sample-verified; export-control screening)
- High-purity copper 5N/6N — https://chinanews.kr/supply/high-purity-copper.html (99.999–99.9999% ingot/rod/granule with GDMS certificates; OFE C10100; Grade A cathode)
- Also supplied: yttrium, gallium, terbium, tungsten, germanium, hafnium, semiconductor materials — https://chinanews.kr/supply/

## Credentials & milestones
- Registered participant in Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation (aT) state trading and WTO/FTA import-rights auctions; 30,000 t Chinese rice export quota; 300,000 t corn quota; overseas supplier Heilongjiang Jinji.
- Direct supply contracts with Hubei Yihua (PBAT) and a Chinese biodegradable-materials platform company.
- June 2026: first Korean company to export SiC focus-ring CVD furnace systems directly to a Chinese semiconductor equipment maker (Heilongjiang Zhilian Semiconductor; 4 lines). Press release: https://chinanews.kr/press/abridge-sic-cvd-20260615.html

## Compliance
Every enquiry is classified under Korea's strategic-items rules (YESTRADE) and screened against U.S. CSL, UN and EU sanctions lists before quotation. Materials ship with producer certificates; samples are available for independent assay.
